title.zh: Fed’s hawkish rate hold keeps pressure on Bitcoin: Analysts
title.en: Fed’s hawkish rate hold keeps pressure on Bitcoin: Analysts

current_state.zh: The Fed held rates at 3.75%–4% with two dissenting votes for a hike and Chair Kevin Warsh flagging persistently above-target inflation, leaving analysts warning that rising Treasury yields, dollar strength and upcoming inflation data will keep pressure on Bitcoin, with markets pricing a 78% chance of a December hike.
